newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Intikeramik rises on debut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Intikeramik rises on debut.

text.p: Indonesian ceramic tile producer PT Intikeramik Alamasri Industry rose by about 30 percent from its offer price on its debut on Wednesday.
The company's shares rose to a high of 975 rupiah against its offer price of 750 rupiah before easing back to 925 rupiah in early trade. Volume was modest at about 30 million shares.
"The response from the market was good. Buying interest particulary from local investors was relatively strong, maybe because its price was quite cheap," a broker with a local firm said.
However, he did not expect the stock to rise much further due to the weak overall market sentiment.
Another local broker said there was nothing extraordinary in the company's fundamentals to spur further buying, although the firm had doubled its net profits in 1996 from 1995.
The price would trade at between 900 and 925 rupiah for the rest of the day, traders said.
In its prospectus, the company said it posted a net profit of 7.51 billion rupiah in 1996, against 3.39 billion rupiah in 1995.
Intikeramik floated 100 million shares, with PT Danareksa Sekuritas and PT Pentasena Arthasentosa acting as lead underwriters.
